mustFix.problem: Photo alt text says 'A snowy residential street in Quebec City. Photographed at Vieux-Limoilou.' and src is season-snow-street-1170.webp. Wrong region for Durham NC site. Round 0 fix claim did not land in the build.
mustFix.fix: Replace with a Durham/NC-appropriate residential street or neighborhood photo from the moving niche media library. Update alt text to describe the actual frame. Verify the new file exists in sites/moving/A/dist/media/ and the src/srcset paths resolve.

mustFix.problem: 404 error on an unnamed resource. Missing assets break polish and may affect accessibility.
mustFix.fix: Identify the failing URL via browser Network tab or build logging, restore the missing file or remove the reference. Re-run check-render to confirm zero console errors.

elevate.move: Art-direct the entire photo set as a single move-day sequence in consistent warm light -- tag close-up, wrap station, ramp load, hallway carry, placed-in-room -- so crops tell a narrative arc. Replace the Quebec snow frame with a Durham neighborhood shot graded to match.

Break the three-light-tone run by making the process story section t-deep with reversed text, creating a paper/deep/paper/deep rhythm that gives the scroll a visible loud-quiet-loud shape and separates the process narrative from the services grid.
